dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Manage your catalog, track revenue, view payouts, and grow your audience — all in one place.

catalog.noAssetsDescription: Upload your first track to get started.

revenue.noRevenueEvents: No revenue events recorded. Events will appear here as your catalog generates income.

splits.title: Royalty Splits
splits.description: Configure how revenue is distributed among collaborators. Splits must total exactly 100%. Each collaborator receives their share after platform and processing fees are deducted.
splits.underAllocated: Under-allocated by {amount}%. All revenue shares must total 100%.

hero.title: Music Without
hero.description: Stream the best of African music — Afrobeats, Amapiano, Highlife, and 40+ genres. Artists earn 85% of every stream. Labels scale across the continent.

stakeholders.title: One Platform,
stakeholders.description: Whether you create, curate, listen, or organize — Zonga is built for you.

listeners.title: For Listeners
listeners.description: Discover the best of African music — Afrobeats, Amapiano, Highlife, Bongo, and more. Follow artists, build playlists, and stream for free.

artists.title: For Artists
artists.description: Distribute your music, earn 85% of revenue, and own your masters — with instant payouts to mobile money, bank, or crypto.

labels.title: For Labels
labels.description: Manage rosters, automate royalty splits, and scale distribution across the continent — with full compliance and reporting.

events.title: For Event Organizers
events.description: Sell tickets, manage events, and connect with fans — powered by the same platform artists already trust.

features.title: Listen, Create,
features.description: Features for listeners who want great music and creators who deserve fair pay — all on one platform.

items.title: Stream & Discover
items.description: Explore millions of tracks across 40+ African genres — from Afrobeats and Amapiano to Highlife and Soukous. Free to stream, always.

items.title: Curated Playlists
items.description: Genre playlists, mood mixes, and regional collections hand-curated for every taste — updated weekly by our editorial team.

items.title: Live Events
items.description: Discover concerts, festivals, and live sessions near you. Buy tickets and follow artists for event alerts.

items.title: Fair Revenue Split
items.description: Transparent royalty calculations with real-time breakdown by stream, download, licensing, sync, and more.

items.title: Instant Payouts
items.description: Request payouts anytime via Orange Money, M-Pesa, MTN MoMo, Flutterwave, or bank transfer. No 90-day holds.

items.title: Full Creative Control
items.description: Artists own their masters. Upload, distribute, and manage your catalog with complete creative ownership.

regions.title: Every Sound,
regions.description: From Lagos to Nairobi, Johannesburg to Dakar — Zonga amplifies the full spectrum of African music.

mission.title: Music That
mission.description: Zonga was born from a simple belief: African music deserves a platform that puts listeners and creators first. Listeners get free access to the richest catalog of African music anywhere. Creators get 85% of every stream. Labels scale effortlessly. Everyone wins.

regions.title: Every Sound,
regions.description: From Lagos to Nairobi, Johannesburg to Dakar — Zonga amplifies the full spectrum of African music.

partnership.title: Built With
partnership.description: Zonga partners with organizations that share our commitment to fair music — from distribution to community impact.

cta.title: Ready to Join the
cta.description: Whether you listen, create, manage, or organize — Zonga is where African music thrives. Stream for free. Distribute your music. Join the movement.
